title: WAC 192-310-010, What reports are required from an employer?

passages.question: When is the Q3 2026 tax and wage report due?
passages.excerpt: The quarterly tax and wage reports are due by the last day of the month following the end of the calendar quarter being reported. ... So, reports are due by April 30th, July 31st, October 31st, and January 31st, in that order. If these dates fall on a Saturday, Sunday, or a legal holiday, the reports will be due on the next business day.

passages.question: What must each employee's line on the report show?
passages.excerpt: (a) Tax report. Each calendar quarter, every employer must file a tax report with the commissioner. The report must list the total wages paid to every employee during that quarter. (b) Report of employees' wages. ... This report must list each employee by full name, Social Security number, standard occupational classification code or job title, and total hours worked and wages paid during that quarter. ... These standard occupational categories are identified by a six-digit numerical code.
